DESIGNS.name: Animal Kingdom
DESIGNS.line: Elephants, giraffes and zebras gather under fan palms. A full jungle scene for one wall.
DESIGNS.ov: A hand-painted jungle with elephants, a giraffe, zebras, a tiger and a hippo under tall fan palms, on a soft white sky. The scene is printed once across your wall, so nothing repeats and no animal is cut in half at a seam.

DESIGNS.name: Sumatra Classic
DESIGNS.line: A misty jungle in sage and cream, with elephant, giraffe and leopard.
DESIGNS.ov: A softer, vintage take on the jungle scene in sage greens and warm cream, with a faded engraving texture. Calm enough for a bedroom, detailed enough for a dining room feature wall.

DESIGNS.name: In Harmony
DESIGNS.line: Fine line art palms with toucans, parrots and monkeys in color.
DESIGNS.ov: Black ink drawings of banana leaves and palms, with only the birds and monkeys in color. Light and airy on a white ground, so it suits smaller rooms.

DESIGNS.name: Calendula
DESIGNS.line: One flower, close up, in soft black and white.
DESIGNS.ov: A macro photograph of a calendula flower in soft greys. Large enough that the petals become shapes; best on one wall behind a bed or sofa.

DESIGNS.name: Wild Bouquet
DESIGNS.line: Banana and calathea leaves in black, white and grey.
DESIGNS.ov: Oversized tropical leaves in greyscale on a plaster-white ground. Graphic and quiet at the same time.

DESIGNS.name: Swaying Palm Leaves
DESIGNS.line: Sepia palm fronds rising from the floor line.
DESIGNS.ov: Feathery palm leaves in warm sepia that rise from the bottom of the wall and fade into the sky. Leaves the top half calm.

DESIGNS.name: Palm Leaves Shadow
DESIGNS.line: The shadow of a palm on a dark plaster wall.
DESIGNS.ov: Afternoon light falling through palm leaves onto a charcoal plaster wall. Moody, warm and very simple.

DESIGNS.name: Shadow Leaf
DESIGNS.line: Soft palm shadows on a white wall.
DESIGNS.ov: The light version of our shadow murals: soft grey palm shadows on white. Feels like a sunny room all day.

DESIGNS.name: Ombre Smokey
DESIGNS.line: A fade from warm sand to deep night blue.
DESIGNS.ov: A smooth gradient from sand at the top to deep navy at the floor. Makes ceilings feel higher.

DESIGNS.name: Luxury Henley
DESIGNS.line: A fade from pale grey to charcoal.
DESIGNS.ov: A soft grey-to-charcoal ombre with a fine paper texture. Works in offices, hallways and hotel corridors.

DESIGNS.name: Jumbo Dog Sketch
DESIGNS.line: Big, loose dog sketches in army green on ivory beige.
DESIGNS.ov: Dozens of dogs drawn in a quick, loose line in army green and blush on ivory. A repeating pattern, so it covers any size of wall with no visible joins.

DESIGNS.name: My Favorite Dogs
DESIGNS.line: Dachshunds, setters and Dalmatians on warm grey.
DESIGNS.ov: Painted dogs of every breed, scattered on a warm grey ground. A repeating pattern for playrooms, mudrooms and dog lovers.

DESIGNS.name: Vine
DESIGNS.line: Fine vines and brushed leaves. Two colorways.
DESIGNS.ov: Thin trailing vines with brush-stroke leaves. Comes in Charcoal (black leaves on white) and Oatmeal (white leaves on warm beige). Chat with the designer for any other color.

DESIGNERS.name: Linden Studio
DESIGNERS.about: We paint big scenes the old way: layer by layer, animal by animal. Every mural is a single picture made to cover a whole wall without a repeat.

DESIGNERS.name: Nora Lind
DESIGNERS.line: Fine line art and quiet florals
DESIGNERS.about: I start with ink on paper and keep most of it white. My murals are for people who want the wall to breathe.

DESIGNERS.name: Yuki Arai
DESIGNERS.line: Ink, gold leaf, and a lot of empty space
DESIGNERS.about: Large leaves, soft greys, nothing extra. I like walls you can look at for a long time.

DESIGNERS.name: Tomás Reyes
DESIGNERS.line: Palms, light and shadow, painted wall by wall
DESIGNERS.about: Most of my work is about afternoon light through leaves. Calm murals for bedrooms, hotels and slow mornings.

DESIGNERS.name: Maren Holt
DESIGNERS.line: Gradients and fine repeats, drawn by hand
DESIGNERS.about: I make the quiet ones: fades that make ceilings feel higher, and fine vines that look like they grew there.

DESIGNERS.name: Inès Okafor
DESIGNERS.line: Bold, happy repeats for kids and dog people
DESIGNERS.about: Dogs, mostly. Big loose drawings and painted breeds, made into patterns that run across any wall.
